input.code:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

theorem sum_reciprocal_n_mul_pred_lt_one (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 2 N) (fun n => (1 : ℚ) / ((n : ℚ) * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) < 1 := by
  have h_closed_form : ∀ (k : ℕ), 2 ≤ k →
    Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 2 k) (fun n => (1 : ℚ) / ((n : ℚ) * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) = 1 - (1 : ℚ) / (k : ℚ) := by
    refine Nat.le_induction (by norm_num) (fun m hm ih => ?_)
    have hm_not_mem : m + 1 ∉ Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) m := by
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      omega
    have hsub : ((m + 1 : ℕ) - 1) = m := by omega
    have hcast : (((m + 1 : ℕ) - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (m : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hsub
    have hIcc_eq : Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) (m + 1) = insert (m + 1) (Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) m) := by
      ext x; simp [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
    rw [hIcc_eq, Finset.sum_insert hm_not_mem, ih, hcast]
    have hm_ne_zero : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      have hpos : 0 < m := by omega
      exact_mod_cast hpos.ne.symm
    have hm_succ_ne_zero : ((m : ℕ) + 1 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      have hpos : 0 < m + 1 := by omega
      exact_mod_cast hpos.ne.symm
    field_simp [hm_ne_zero, hm_succ_ne_zero]
    ring
  have h_eq := h_closed_form N hN
  rw [h_eq]
  have hNpos : (0 : ℚ) < (N : ℚ) := by
    have h : 0 < N := by omega
    exact_mod_cast h
  have h_div_pos : 0 < (1 : ℚ) / (N : ℚ) := div_pos (by norm_num) hNpos
  linarith
